channel.title: Houston Public Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Houston Public Media (houstonpublicmedia.org)

item.title: Harris County commissioners appoint Erica Lee Carter as new county administrator
item.description: The position is charged with leading the Office of County Administration, which has overseen the day-to-day operations and long-term strategic plans of the county's largest departments since its establishment in 2021.

item.title: Rain or shine, Galveston Island prepares for weekend two of Mardi Gras celebrations
item.description: City officials tout Galveston’s Mardi Gras celebration as the third largest in the country and the largest in Texas, with more than 400,000 visitors each year.

item.title: Texas A&M pauses plan for new $235M Center for Learning Arts and Innovation
item.description: The five-story, 186,900-square-foot building was originally expected to begin construction in late 2026, according to the government procurement consulting firm Strategic Partnerships, Inc.

item.title: Hello Houston (February 13, 2026)
item.description: Today: We talk with U.S. Representative Jasmine Crockett about her run for Senate, Dr. Viviana Coles shares relationship advice, we explore the influence Christian nationalism is having on politics, and much more.

item.title: Hello Houston – The Commuter Cut (February 13, 2026)
item.description: For our busy Houston commuters, we have – The Commuter Cut – a special 40-minute version of our show to listen to during your journey home.

item.title: No tax hike despite budget headache, Whitmire says in State of the City address
item.description: In addition to addressing fiscal challenges, Whitmire unveiled aspirational visions — like a light rail connection to the airport, water taxis on the bayou and giant drainage pipes along I-10.

item.title: Tornado warning issued for parts of Houston area as Saturday night storms move through
item.description: Across the Southeast Texas region, the National Weather Service warned of wind gusts up to 60 mph, along with heavy rain, lightning and hail.
